top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single part on GLP-1 physiology and its active form to Holst, Drucker and Mojsov. The chain from the incretin effect and native GLP-1 physiology, through proglucagon processing and receptor biology, to identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide is continuous, has been independently confirmed for about three decades and is validated by large randomized cardiovascular, renal and weight trials. The citation rewards the discovery, not the drug development. Attribution (Habener omitted, contested priority) is the residual weakness, but it does not justify withholding the prize.
